IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. High RMSE spread (4.12) and unstable rankings necessitate robust combiners like median/trimmed mean to avoid overfitting noisy model disagreements.
